facts.fact: The Prime Minister launched on 9 February 2026 the national data governance system under presidential decree of 30 December 2025, which he said aims to ensure control, organisation and protection of public data in a sovereign model.

High Commissioner Benmouloud said the strategic infrastructure is complete, with data centres in service, cloud accounts deployed and the sovereign IRIES network linking over 55 state bodies in a closed environment outside the Internet.
